decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and numbered CgMs/12917/a, CgMs/12917/b, AIR VH - 300, AIR VH - 400 and AIR VH - 500 and palisade fence details and Design & Access Statement, Transport Statement

Received 14 July 2011

Email correspondence received 26 August 2011and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development other than the demolition of the building shall take place until details of a Sustainable Urban Drainage Scheme, including measures for the minimisation of water run-off from the  footprint area of the demolished building by at least 50% of that of an undeveloped site, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and retained and maintained thereafter.
description: Erection of new fencing and demolition of Unit 2 to enable  use of the land for vehicle compound/parking in association with existing security company control centre operating from Victory House.
